context: 2026-11-15 evidence: Spark TPC-DI SF 1 under `make uat-cell` on a 16 GiB host. `bounded_default_driver_memory` sized the heap from the 8 GiB budget less a 3 GiB allowance, yet the JVM footprint reached 7.80 GiB and the watchdog killed the tree at 8.08 GiB after 452 s. The same workload with `driver_memory=3g` finished in 451 s with all queries passing. The 3 GiB JVM-and-Python allowance in `benchbox/platforms/spark.py` is too small for this workload.
